observations.behavior: Adds a Django management command to migrate HogFlow and HogFlowRevision records, converting the conversion.window_minutes integer field to a duration-string window field, while leaving values above the legacy ceiling untouched.
observations.posthog_connection: This command would be run against existing database records to perform a representation change without changing the measured conversion rate. It also updates HogFlowRevision records and HogFlow.draft records. The tier is limited because the actual database migration and model changes are not supplied.
